2026-11-25 CME settlements. Dec 26 49.925 (-1.875) CONFIRMED by TWO independent routes plus an exact tick-valid chain: Brownfield Ag News' Nov 25 livestock close ("December lean hogs closed $1.87 lower at $49.92", page modified 2026-11-25T21:29Z = 15:29 CT, after the 13:05 CT close) and the GX94 closing commodity table bylined 2026-11-25 2:25 PM ("LEAN HOGS DEC 49.92 down 1.87"). BOTH TRUNCATE TO 2dp - a behaviour this file has already documented for GX94 (it printed 56.42 for a true 56.425 on 2026-11-24). The only tick-valid pair consistent with both printings is 49.925 / -1.875: 49.925/0.025 = 1997 and 1.875/0.025 = 75 are both whole ticks, whereas the literal 49.92 (1996.8 ticks) and -1.88 (75.2 ticks) are both impossible on a 0.025 tick. It chains EXACTLY to the 2026-11-24 Dec settlement of 51.800: 51.800 - 1.875 = 49.925. Feb 27 55.425 (-1.00) CONFIRMED by THREE independent routes: Pro Farmer 'After the Bell' published 2026-11-25 01:55 PM CT ("February lean hog futures fell $1.00 to $55.425 ... hit another contract low") which pins the third decimal, plus Brownfield (55.42) and GX94 ("LEAN HOGS FEB 55.42 down 1.00"); chains exactly off the 2026-11-24 Feb settlement of 56.425. || APR 27 WAS NOT OBTAINABLE FOR 2026-11-25 and is NOT relabelled. It is held at its verified 2026-11-24 value of 63.85 with an EXPLICIT per-field "asof": "2026-11-24" inside latest['Apr 27'], so no field asserts a date it does not have. Nothing in pi.py, report.py or charts.py reads latest['Apr 27'] (only latest['Dec 26']['px'] is consumed), so no April figure reaches the PDF or PI under a 2026-11-25 label. Routes tried for April and why each failed: Brownfield and GX94 print only DEC and FEB hog lines; Pro Farmer printed only February; Farmbucks served a STALE 2026-11-24 snapshot (timestamp "Nov 24, 1:04 PM UTC-6", every month identical to the values this file already held for 2026-11-24, so it was rejected rather than written); barchart.com and cmegroup.com both returned PROVENANCE_REQUIRED, needing an interactive approval no one was present to give; westerngrainmarketing.com is robots-disallowed; agupdate and admis.com returned client errors; the Barchart daily hog wire covering the 2026-11-25 close had not been published or indexed by run time (its 2026-11-24 edition WAS obtained - see below). The curve entry for 2026-11-25 therefore holds only Dec and Feb, a deliberately PARTIAL snapshot, which has precedent in the 2026-11-05 entry (5 months). apr27 got NO 2026-11-25 series point - RUNBOOK is explicit not to pad the series. || STRONG INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION OF THE 2026-11-24 SET obtained this session: the Barchart daily hog wire for the 2026-11-24 close ("Hogs Close Lower on Tuesday as Cutout Goes on Pre-Thanksgiving Sale", read via TradingView syndication) prints "Dec 26 Hogs closed at $51.800, down $0.650", "Feb 27 Hogs closed at $56.425, down $0.850" and "Apr 27 Hogs closed at $63.850, down $0.175". That is a THIRD route for Dec and Feb and - importantly - it CONFIRMS TO THE THIRD DECIMAL the -0.175 April change that the 2026-11-24 run had to reconstruct from a single Farmbucks printing of -0.18 / -0.27%. The reconstruction was correct. || oi/vol were NOT reachable for 2026-11-25 (Farmbucks, the only route that carries them, was stale) and were OMITTED rather than carried forward from 2026-11-24. Neither field is rendered. Each contract keeps its own history; no continuous front-month series was spliced. perf 1d/1w recomputed from verified closes (1w vs the 2026-11-18 Dec close of 51.35: 49.925/51.35 - 1 = -2.78%); ytd/1y unchanged and not rendered.

|| 2026-11-27 RUN: NO NEW SETTLEMENT EXISTS TO WRITE AND NOTHING WAS APPENDED. 2026-11-26 was Thanksgiving and CME livestock was closed, so 2026-11-25 is the most recent settled session; today's abbreviated session (livestock closes 12:05 CT the day after Thanksgiving) had not settled at run time. This block is therefore flagged CORE-STALE at age 2d against a 0d limit purely as an artifact of the calendar and the pre-close run time, NOT because a published figure was missed - there is no 11-26 or 11-27 settlement in existence. The held 2026-11-25 values were CORROBORATED this session: ThePigSite's CME wire published 2026-11-26 states 'Most-active February hogs settled a penny lower at 55.425 cents per pound', matching the Feb 55.425 held here exactly, and 56.425 - 1.000 chains it onto the confirmed 11-24 settlement. The Dec 49.925 (-1.875 off 51.80) remains as held. The 11-20 curve was also re-validated independently: Ag Optimus's 2026-11-23 COT report gives Dec 52.600 and Feb 56.975 for Friday 11-20 and Dec 53.100 / Feb 58.325 for Tuesday 11-17, all matching this block's curve to the cent, and the Barchart wire for the 11-20 close adds Apr 64.675, also matching. STILL MISSING: an Apr 27 settlement for 2026-11-25. latest['Apr 27'] therefore keeps its own explicit 2026-11-24 asof of 63.85 and the apr27 series still ends at 11-24 - it was NOT padded, per RUNBOOK section 5. The only Apr figure found for 11-25 was 63.150, and it was rejected: the Barchart page carrying it describes those levels as 'midday losses of 70 cents to $1.57 so far on Wednesday' in its own meta description while the body calls them closes, and its Dec figure of 50.225 is demonstrably NOT the settlement, since Dec settled 49.925. LH_INDEX.src:
CME || 2026-11-24 RUN: held at 2026-11-18 (56.32). No newer index value published to any reachable source. One consistency check was available and PASSES: the CME wire published 2026-11-19 quotes the index "last quoted at 56.86 cents per pound, its lowest value since August 2020", which is exactly the 2026-11-16 value held in this series and confirms the two-business-day publication lag that this block's convention assumes. || 2026-11-25 RUN: held at 2026-11-18 (56.32). A NEWER value was found and NOT written: the Barchart daily hog wire for the 2026-11-24 close states "The CME Lean Hog Index was down 46 cents on November 20 at $55.31". It is plausible and continues the decline this series already shows (56.86 on 11-16, 56.32 on 11-18), and it implies a 2026-11-19 value of 55.77 that was never published anywhere reachable. It is NOT written because it is SINGLE-SOURCED and, unlike the 56.32 now held, it comes with NO independent arithmetic check - the 56.32 was admitted on a single source only because it reconciled EXACTLY against two separately verified figures (56.32 - 52.60 = the published 3.72 basis over December, and 57.73 - 55.35 = the published 2.38 basis for 11-16). No published basis figure exists to test 55.31 against, so it does not meet the bar the held value met. LH_INDEX['latest'] feeds PI's cash block directly, so admitting it would move the indicator on one unchecked number. || A CONFLICTING FIGURE WAS ALSO SEEN AND REJECTED: Price Group's weekly ag report published 2026-11-25 states "The CME Lean Hog Index was down another $2.46 this week at $58.78 as of November 18". That contradicts the 56.32 held here for the same date. It is judged WRONG and the held value is kept: 58.78 is exactly this series' own 2026-11-11 value, i.e. the publisher appears to be a week behind on this field, its implied prior of 61.24 appears nowhere in the series, and its COT field is likewise a week stale (positions "week ending 11/17" in a 2026-11-25 piece). Its cutout field, by contrast, is internally correct for the week ending 11-20 (down 1.67 to 67.88, chaining off the 69.55 held for 11-13), so the piece is not wholly unreliable - only its index date is. Per RUNBOOK, two sources disagreeing materially means the figure stays unverified and the gate flags it.

|| 2026-11-27 RUN: ADVANCED from 2026-11-18 (56.32) to 2026-11-23 (55.02); 2026-11-20 (55.31) appended with it. This block is now FRESH. The 2026-11-25 run held 55.31 out as single-sourced with no arithmetic check. What changed this session: (1) THE ANCHOR IS NOW TRIPLE-CONFIRMED. The 56.32 for 2026-11-18 is stated by the Barchart wire for the 2026-11-20 close ('The CME Lean Hog Index was down 27 cents on November 18 at $56.32') AND by Ag Optimus's COT report published 2026-11-23 ('The CME Lean Hog Index was $56.32 for Nov. 18'), on top of the two basis reconciliations already recorded above. (2) THE TWO NEW POINTS CHAIN EXACTLY ACROSS TWO SEPARATE PUBLICATION DAYS. The Barchart wire for the 2026-11-24 close states 'The CME Lean Hog Index was down 46 cents on November 20 at $55.31'; the Barchart wire for the 2026-11-25 close states 'The CME Lean Hog Index was down 29 cents on November 23 at $55.02'. 55.31 - 0.29 = 55.02 exactly, so each wire's stated level and stated change reproduce the other's level. A mis-parse would have to recur self-consistently on two different days AND land on a value continuing the independently confirmed 56.32. (3) These are PROSE figures in a narrative wire, not a parsed AMS table, so the column-summing failure mode RUNBOOK warns about does not apply; and the 2026-11-25 run re-confirmed three of this file's PM cutout values from the same Barchart wire series 'all three matching to the cent'. (4) Direction and magnitude agree with every other cash series this session - cutout 68.66 -> 66.98 and producer base 60.04 -> 57.67 over the same span. LIMITATION, STATED PLAINLY: this remains ONE publisher. There is no published basis figure for 11-20 or 11-23 to test against, so this is weaker than the 56.32 admission, which reconciled against two separately verified figures. It is written because LH_INDEX['latest'] feeds PI's cash block and a 9-day-old index was distorting the basis component more than the residual parse risk on a two-day self-consistent chain. REJECTED AGAIN THIS SESSION: Price Group's Ag Marketing Report of 2026-11-25 repeats 'The CME Lean Hog Index was down another $2.46 this week at $58.78 as of November 18'. 58.78 is this series' own 2026-11-11 value, i.e. the same one-week publication lag the 2026-11-25 run diagnosed. It is wrong and is not used. Implied but NOT written: a 2026-11-19 value of about 55.77 (56.32 -> 55.31 is -1.01 while the 11-20 change is stated as -0.46); no source publishes 11-19, so no point was invented for it and the series simply skips that date.
